discover_functorch_transform_coverage: run discover_coverage.py to discover functorch vmap, vjp, and jvp coverage for PyTorch ops
get_public_overridable_apis: get all public overridable PyTorch APIs by parsing documentation RST files
get_top_ops: get the top N most-used torch and nn.functional ops from GitHub usage data
query_operator_support: query an OperatorSet to find which ops support vmap, vjp, jvp, or their combinations
print_coverage_info: print a coverage report showing which top ops fail vmap, vjp, or jvp tests
